title: Strategic Customer Success Manager
description:
About the role 
We are looking for an ambitious and experienced Strategic Customer Success Manager. In this role, you are part of a fast-growing Customer Success team and build strong relationships with the largest global network accounts in the Accounting industry.
You take responsibility for the Customer Success strategy and the continuous growth of our existing customer portfolio. Your efforts will drive customer value and outcomes as well as uncover additional uses for our product. If you care about delivering value to customers, we would love to talk to you!
 Why DataSnipper? 
Audit and finance are still massively manual, and we’re changing that. DataSnipper is a $1B, bootstrapped unicorn with 600,000+ users across 180+ countries, already embedded in the daily workflows of top audit and accounting firms.
Now, we’re taking things further with our Excel Agent, bringing AI directly into where the work actually happens. Unlike generic AI tools, we don’t sit on the sidelines. Our AI operates inside Excel, with access to real documents and audit evidence — meaning it doesn’t just generate answers, it does the work, with full traceability.
We’re not just applying AI, we’re redefining how audit gets done. If you want to build something category-defining at scale, this is the place.
 What you will do 
 Enterprise Account Planning: Develop and execute success plans specifically designed for our strategic customers. Work closely with Sales, Marketing, and Product teams to develop the Customer Success strategy and to drive customer engagement.
 Relationship Management: Cultivate and nurture multi-threaded relationships with key stakeholders across complex global customers. Understand their business goals, challenges, and technology needs.
 Revenue Expansion: Drive customer expansion by identifying opportunities for upsell, cross-sell, and additional value-added services. Collaborate closely with other GTM teams to maximize value from these high-profile accounts.
 Customer Advocacy: Establish and grow a customer advocacy program within strategic customers. Leverage success stories and testimonials to highlight the impact of DataSnipper's solutions within this prestigious customer base.
 Improve the CS organization & beyond: Create & optimize processes for the strategic accounts team and beyond.
 What you bring 
5+ years in a customer success role, with a proven track record in working with global enterprise clients
Possess a proactive mindset with a drive to innovate, develop new processes, and take on strategic initiatives aimed at achieving future-focused business outcomes
Demonstrate strong project and time management skills with the ability to self-start, own tasks, and deliver successful results for customers
Exceptional verbal and written communication skills, including the ability to present to executives and key decision-makers
Strong affinity with the software industry and understanding of B2B relationships
Full working proficiency in English
 What We Offer: 
Be part of one of the fastest-growing, profitable unicorn scale-ups in the Netherlands with a global impact
Equity (Stock Appreciation Rights) to share the company's success and growth
Pension plan with a 6% contribution on top of your base salary
28 vacation days per year (full-time) to support your work-life balance
Hybrid work model with at least 3 days onsite in our dynamic Amsterdam office
Daily, freshly prepared lunches by our in-house chef to keep you energized
NS business card for easy commuting to the office
Access to continuous learning and development initiatives to grow your skills
Engage with a vibrant international team spread across five global offices
Company-wide events like DataSnipper GO, where global teams come together
Access to OpenUp, a mental health and wellness platform supporting your wellbeing
 Recruitment Process 
Recruiter Screen (30 minutes, online)
Hiring Manager Interview (30 minutes, online)
Assessment Interview (1 hour, on-site)
Final Interview (30 minutes, online) 
 Ready to Elevate Your Career? 
 Apply now and let’s explore how you can make an impact at DataSnipper! 🚀

description:
🚀 About Borderless
 At Borderless, we’re building a world where borders are no longer barriers — where anyone can move anywhere, seamlessly and safely.
Founded in 2023, we’ve already helped 600+ UK businesses and 15,000+ individuals navigate the complexity of immigration.
Powered by technology and supported by an expert team, our platform removes the friction of Home Office compliance, visa processing and sponsor licence applications — making immigration faster, simpler and more accessible for everyone.
Backed by Entrepreneur First and Backed.VC , we’re scaling quickly and in 2026 expanding into new sectors and markets to accelerate our growth.
 Also 25% of our workforce is sponsored, and we proudly offer visa sponsorship as part of our hiring process.
 🎯 Role Overview
 We are looking for a Revenue Operations Lead to build and scale the systems, data and processes that power our go-to-market teams.
You will report directly to our CEO and own RevOps end to end as our only dedicated RevOps hire. There is no inherited playbook and no committee to work through: you decide how the revenue engine gets built, then you build it, with the room to grow the function around you as we scale.
Our north star for your first three months: HubSpot is the trusted source of truth for the business, clean, measurable and connected, and RevOps has moved from fixing the foundations to producing the insight that shapes planning and forecasting for the quarter ahead.
This is a high-ownership role responsible for the systems, data, processes and insights that support our Sales, Marketing and Customer Success teams.
You will own our CRM (Hubspot), GTM tech stack and revenue data, ensuring the business has clear visibility across the full customer journey - from lead generation through to customer expansion.
The right person will combine fantastic verbal and written communication with strong systems thinking and commercial understanding, helping our teams operate faster, make better decisions and continuously improve performance.
This role sits at the centre of our revenue engine, enabling SDRs, marketing, partnerships, AEs and Customer Success teams to work more effectively while providing leadership with clear insight into pipeline health, performance and growth opportunities.
 🎯 Role Responsibilities
 Revenue Data & Reporting
Build and manage pipeline reporting, revenue forecasting and executive reporting.
Define and track key revenue metrics across the full funnel, creating dashboards for Sales, Marketing and leadership to monitor pipeline health and performance.
Provide insights to leadership on pipeline trends, revenue performance and growth opportunities.
 CRM & GTM Systems
Own CRM (Hubspot) structure, hygiene and governance.
Own and optimise the GTM tech stack, including CRM, sales tooling, marketing automation and attribution platforms.
Define consistent revenue metrics, data definitions and reporting standards across GTM teams.
Improve systems through automation, experimentation and new tooling.
 GTM Processes
Design and optimise GTM processes and document playbooks used by Sales, Marketing and Customer Success.
Partner with Marketing on lead scoring, segmentation and nurture flows.
 Attribution & Performance
Implement attribution models across inbound, outbound, events, partnerships and paid channels.
Measure campaign performance and analyse funnel conversion to improve pipeline generation and revenue efficiency.
 Outbound systems and GTM engineering
Own the outbound data layer, including target lists, enrichment waterfalls and signal sourcing.
Identify prospect buying signals, turning them into sequenced, scored and routed plays for the SDR team to work.
Own sending infrastructure, including domains, deliverability, sequencers and reply handling.
Measure performance with the SDR team, and retire what does not convert.
 Cross-functional Enablement
Ensure GTM teams operate from a shared, trusted view of revenue data and systems.
 🎯 Your first 90 days
 We would rather tell you what good looks like than leave you to guess.
 First 30 days: learn the engine
Get under the bonnet of HubSpot and the wider GTM stack, and work out where every number comes from and where the numbers disagree with each other
Sit with the SDRs, AEs, Marketing, Partnerships and Customer Success teams, and understand how each of them actually works today

Stretch: our reporting has moved off spreadsheets and into something connected to live HubSpot data
 By 90 days: the system produces decisions

Forecast accuracy tracked for the current quarter, and a forecast for the next one that leadership can plan against

The revenue initiatives you defined at 60 days built and delivered

description:
Who we are 
At illumin, we are transforming the advertising landscape. Our platform offers an integrated space for journey planning, execution, and reporting. It empowers marketers to connect with their audiences in powerful ways through real-time data and easy-to-use visual tools. By seamlessly combining media planning and buying in an intuitive interface, marketers can take complete control of their campaigns, meeting customers wherever they are in the buying journey and maximizing the impact of their ad spend through personalized insights for smarter decision-making.
We are at a pivotal moment, evolving into a product-led company with a team of over 100 skilled professionals and new leadership guiding our path forward. By harnessing the power of data, advancing our AI capabilities, and deeply investing in our people, we are preparing for a future that will redefine what’s possible in journey advertising.
Our work is guided by two beliefs: that the ability to execute is paramount to success and that we are only as good as our people. As we grow and transform, we are looking for team members (illumineers) who share our bias for speed, delivery over perfection, and an entrepreneurial mindset. Joining us now is a chance to be part of our transformation.
 Who we need 
Reporting to the COO, we are hiring a Manager, Revenue Operations to drive operational excellence across our revenue organization. You will be the strategic partner behind our sales performance, responsible for ensuring that processes, systems, reporting, forecasting, and planning activities enable sustainable growth. You will work closely with Sales leadership, Finance, Marketing, Customer Success, and Technology teams to create structure, visibility, and scalability across the revenue engine.
 This is a hybrid opportunity, working three days per week on-site in our downtown Toronto office. Our headquarters are located within minutes of St. Andrew and Union subway stations. 
 What's in it for you 
 Impact and visibility. This is an opportunity to play a critical role in how illumin grows and scales. You will work directly with the COO and Sales leadership to improve the systems, processes, and insights that drive revenue performance across the organization. Your recommendations will influence decisions around forecasting, territory planning, compensation, reporting, and operational strategy, giving you visibility into the business beyond a traditional Revenue Operations role.
 The opportunity to build and improve. We are looking for someone who enjoys identifying opportunities, challenging the status quo, and creating better ways of working. You will have the autonomy to evaluate existing processes, uncover inefficiencies, and introduce improvements that increase visibility, adoption, and operational effectiveness. You will have the opportunity to shape how Revenue Operations evolves as the organization grows.
 Strategic exposure and growth. This role sits at the intersection of Sales, Finance, Marketing, Customer Success, and Technology, providing broad exposure to how a growing AdTech business operates. You will partner with leaders across functions to solve complex challenges, influence decision-making, and drive initiatives from idea through execution. Whether your long-term path is senior Revenue Operations leadership, Business Operations, or broader operational leadership, this role offers the opportunity to expand your scope, strengthen your commercial acumen, and make a measurable impact across the organization.
 How you will make an impact: 
 Partner with leadership to improve revenue performance.  Own the systems, processes, and reporting that support the revenue organization.  Drive execution while continuously improving how the business operates. This is a hands-on role where you will balance day-to-day operational responsibilities with longer-term improvement initiatives. You will proactively identify gaps, investigate challenges, introduce best practices, and help build a culture of accountability, data-driven decision-making, and continuous improvement across the revenue organization.
 What you bring:

 The proactive mindset. You do not wait for problems to surface before taking action.  The process and systems expertise. This is a hands-on role for a commercially-minded operator who thrives in ambiguity and is excited to build from zero. You'll work with our largest and most complex customers - and the ones with the most potential - to drive renewals, find expansion opportunities, and turn usage into value and value into growth.

At Braze, we have found our people. We’re a genuinely approachable, exceptionally kind, and intensely passionate crew.
We seek to ignite that passion by setting high standards, championing teamwork, and creating work-life harmony as we collectively navigate rapid growth on a global scale while striving for greater equity and opportunity – inside and outside our organization.
To flourish here, you must be prepared to set a high bar for yourself and those around you. There is always a way to contribute: Acting with autonomy, having accountability and being open to new perspectives are essential to our continued success.
Our deep curiosity to learn and our eagerness to share diverse passions with others gives us balance and injects a one-of-a-kind vibrancy into our culture.
If you are driven to solve exhilarating challenges and have a bias toward action in the face of change, you will be empowered to make a real impact here, with a sharp and passionate team at your back. If Braze sounds like a place where you can thrive, we can’t wait to meet you.
Full-time - Level 4 Analyst
 What You'll Do 
As a Senior Sales Operations Analyst, you will be a key partner to our AMER sales leadership team to help support long-term growth. This role blends hands-on execution with a strategic lens. You will be responsible for maintaining the data and processes the region runs on today, while bringing data-driven recommendations to the table on how we should scale our processes and build the team to support continued growth.
 Territory, Quota & Capacity Planning 
Lead our annual territory carve for AMER, getting into the weeds of the underlying data to ensure accuracy and equitability, and bringing clear, data-driven recommendations on how we should structure territories to drive focus while giving reps a realistic path to hit their targets.
Build capacity models that translate growth targets into recommended headcount, territory coverage, and quota scenarios for leadership to evaluate.
 Scaling Our Processes 
Bring data-driven recommendations for how our sales processes need to evolve as the region and company grow, identifying bottlenecks before they slow the business down.
Partner with our Business Systems team to scope and prioritize Salesforce flows and automations.
Continuously evaluate where manual, one-off, or tribal-knowledge processes need to become documented and repeatable.
 Data & Reporting Infrastructure 
Design dashboards (Tableau, Looker, Salesforce, Clari) that give leadership real time visibility into performance.
Analyze sales data, KPIs, and trends to surface insights on what is working and what isn’t, and provide recommendations on where leaders should focus their attention.
Partner with Sales Leadership on forecasting cadences and keep forecast data clean, current, and trustworthy.
 AI-Driven Process Improvement 
Identify opportunities to use AI tools to automate manual Sales Ops workflows, such as data analysis and process improvement.
Design AI-driven workflows to improve efficiency across the broader sales team.
 Who You Are 
Bachelor's degree in a quantitative or business-oriented field, or equivalent practical experience.
 4+ years of experience in Go-to-Market Operations, Sales Strategy and Operations, or Revenue Operations at a high growth B2B SaaS company.
Technically savvy, with a solid understanding of how Salesforce flows and automations work and a sense for the art of the possible; you won't be building these yourself, but you'll partner closely with our Business Systems team to scope, prioritize, and validate the right builds.
Hands-on experience with Sales tech stack tools such as Clay , ZoomInfo, Clari, Gong, or Fullcast.
Proficient with Google Sheets and BI tools such as Tableau or Looker, with experience building dashboards from scratch.
Comfortable using AI tools to speed up analysis, data cleaning, and reporting, and curious about where AI can remove manual work from Sales Ops processes.
Strong analytical and problem solving skills, with the attention to detail to get into the data and make data driven decisions.
Excellent stakeholder management skills; able to present data and findings to senior sales leaders clearly and concisely, and to build trust quickly.
A creative, solutions oriented thinker who is energized by ambiguous problems that don't have an existing answer.
A proactive self starter who takes initiative without waiting to be asked.
For candidates based in the United States, the pay range for this position at the start of employment is expected to be between $84,000 and $132,000/year, with an expected On Target Earnings (OTE) between $95,000 and $136,000/year (including bonus or commission).Your exact offer may vary depending on multiple individualized factors, including market location, job-related knowledge, skills, and experience. Built on a foundation of composable intelligence, BrazeAI™ allows marketers to combine and activate AI agents, models, and features at every touchpoint throughout the Braze Customer Engagement Platform for smarter, faster, and more meaningful customer engagement. From cross-channel messaging and journey orchestration to Al-powered decisioning and optimization, Braze enables companies to turn action into interaction through autonomous, 1:1 personalized experiences.

title: Revenue Operations Manager - Demand Generation
description:
About SoSafe
 SoSafe is a leading human risk management platform designed to transform the "human factor" from a security vulnerability into a proactive layer of defense. We focus on driving measurable behavior change and quantifiable risk reduction for our global customers.
 Your Role: Architect of Our Demand Engine
 As Revenue Operations Manager for Demand Generation, you will own the end-to-end operational architecture connecting Marketing, our SDR organization, and Account Executives into a single, cohesive pipeline creation engine. Rather than viewing demand in isolated channel silos, you will design the infrastructure, data routing, and AI-native automations that fuel both Inbound and Outbound motions.
You will ensure that every inbound handoff is seamless and that outbound prospecting is hyper-targeted toward our highest-converting opportunities; directly counteracting broader SaaS industry trends where late-stage conversion rates have tightened..
 What You Will Own (key Responsibilities)
Own the Holistic Lead & Pipeline Lifecycle: Design, optimize, and oversee the full demand funnel from initial buyer signal to Closed-Won deal. Bridge the gap between HubSpot Marketing automation, Salesloft cadences, and Salesforce CRM to eliminate lead leakage and friction.
Operationalize Our 2026 ICP & Intent Signals: Hardwire our target ICP criteria, EU mid-market organizations with 500–5,000 employees in regulated industries (Manufacturing, Healthcare, Finance, Public Sector), into our lead scoring and routing logic. Use Clay and Zapier to enrich accounts based on Microsoft 365 tech stack indicators and regulatory pressure signals (e.g., NIS2, DORA compliance deadlines).
Supercharge SDR & AE Outbounding: Build automated prospecting workflows that allow SDRs and AEs to discover, enrich, and add target ICP contacts into Salesloft cadences with one click.
Channel Efficiency & Attribution: Track and optimize lead-to-opportunity conversion metrics across all GTM motions. Capitalize on data showing that AE-sourced pipeline yields significantly higher win rates than traditional cold marketing leads, using insights to reallocate GTM focus dynamically.
Introduce AI-Native Lead Generation: Partner with our dedicated GTM Engineer to implement cutting-edge AI use cases across the top of the funnel. Drive automated lead enrichment, intent-based account prioritization, and automated meeting scheduling to maximize representative output per hour.
Pipeline Health & Target Setting: Partner with Marketing Leadership, Sales Leadership, and the Revenue Operations team to set MQL/SQL targets, track funnel velocity, and maintain a robust unweighted pipeline coverage ratio of 3-4x across all territories.
 What You Bring (requirements)
Experience: 5+ years of professional experience in Revenue Operations, Marketing Operations, or Sales Operations within a high-growth B2B SaaS environment.
Holistic GTM Perspective: You view demand generation as a single team sport. You understand how marketing campaigns, SDR outbound cadences, AE self-prospecting, and channel partner motions interact to create a pipeline.
Tech Stack Mastery: Advanced experience administering and integrating HubSpot (Marketing Suite), Salesforce (SFDC), and Salesloft. Experience with data orchestrators like Clay, Zapier, and forecasting platforms like Clari is highly preferred.
Data-Driven by heart: Fluency across core SaaS funnel metrics, including MQL-to-SQL Conversion, Cost per Opportunity, Win Rates by Channel, CAC Payback, and Pipeline Velocity. 
Process Engineering Mindset: You excel at translating complex go-to-market strategies into automated, fail-safe system logic with clear SLA governance between Marketing, SDRs, and AEs.
 Why Join the SoSafe RevOps Team?
A Seat at the Table: Our RevOps organization manages the entire GTM stack and architecture. You will have direct exposure to executive leaders (CRO, COO, and Director of RevOps) and have a large, visible impact on our profitability journey.
Cutting-Edge Stack: We don’t tolerate legacy tech debt. You will work with a modern infrastructure, including Salesforce, HubSpot, Salesloft, Clari CoPilot, and cutting-edge tools like Clay or Claude.
Team Culture: Join a highly collaborative group of operations professionals and GTM engineers who balance top-tier technical performance with wit, humility, and zero ego. And join our fun team events!
 What we offer*
Work/Life balance: Flexible hours, 33 vacation days
Wellbeing and financial support: Access to Open Up, corporate discounts
Connection & community: Virtual events, collaborative team activities, and opportunities for local meet-ups
And the list goes on: Tech equipment, referral bonuses, dog-friendly HQ

Backed by leading VCs like Highland Europe and Global Founders Capital, we’re rapidly expanding across the globe. We’re looking for team players who want to drive meaningful change in cybersecurity, take ownership of their work, and grow with us.

title: Senior RevOps Manager
description:
Hi 👋 We’re Legl. 
 Legl is building the operating system for modern legal services. 
 We help law firms and regulated businesses replace manual, fragmented workflows with intelligent software from client onboarding and compliance to payments, risk, and reporting. 
 Legal work is high-stake - it’s regulated, complex, and deeply impactful - and our mission is to help regulated firms grow faster, run their businesses more profitably, manage risk intelligently, and deliver great client experiences 
 We’re backed by leading European VCs, scaling quickly, partnered with over 600 law firms including 50 of the UK’s top 200, launched in the UK and Australia - and entering our next phase of growth. 
 We Work Best When 
 AI is the central-operating model: not a tool or a future plan - but the way we run. 
 Decisions live with people: you're trusted to make calls and own them. 
 Think deeply, execute quickly: speed and rigour, not speed or rigour. 
 What You’ll Do 
 As Legl's Senior RevOps Manager , you own how revenue moves through the business - from a lead landing in HubSpot, through signature, launch and ramp, to a customer using the product at the level we expected when they signed. Legl gets paid for what customers use, not how many we sign, so this role covers the whole funnel: Sales & Marketing, Launch & Implementation and Customer Success. 
 Own HubSpot as our commercial system of record - l ead routing, pipeline stages, deal hygiene and the data model underneath them, so that the CRM reflects reality and sales leadership can forecast from it with confidence. 
 Connect marketing to pipeline - define with Marketing what a qualified lead is, own the handover to Sales, and build the attribution reporting that shows which channels and campaigns turn into revenue. 
 Run the sales forecast - build the process and tooling that turns pipeline data into an accurate forecast, and keep it accurate as the business scales. 
 Track ramp and forecast usage - follow every new customer from go-live against what we expected at signature, build a bottom-up usage and revenue forecast by account, and explain the gap between forecast and actual each month to CS, Sales and Finance. 
 Build the reporting leadership runs on - maintain the core commercial reporting in HubSpot and Metabase, write your own SQL when the standard reports don't answer the question, and get usage and revenue data in front of AEs and CSMs inside the CRM. 
 Find where deals slow down and fix it - analyse cycle time by stage and segment, take the findings to the sales team, and drive the changes that speed deals up. 
 Lead change across the commercial motion - when the sales or CS playbook needs to change, design the new process, document it, land it with the team, and report back on what worked and what didn't. 
 Build AI into how the commercial team works - design and deploy agentic workflows across the commercial stack, with clear judgement about where AI belongs and which data should never go near it. 
 This Role Is a Great Fit If You… 
 Are experienced in revenue operations at a B2B SaaS scaleup, and have owned HubSpot as the system of record - you've designed the pipeline and data model, not just kept it tidy. 
 Have worked in a usage-based or consumption-priced business and know first-hand that a signed deal is only the start of the revenue funnel. 
 Have built a forecast that leadership relied on, and can explain how you made it accurate. 
 Are comfortable in SQL and a BI tool such as Metabase, and would rather write the query than wait for someone else to. 
 Have worked across the whole funnel - you understand how Marketing, Sales and Customer Success hand off to each other and where revenue goes missing between them. 
 Have taken difficult findings to a sales team and got them to act - you can make the case with data and hold your ground in the room. 
 Have rolled out process change to a commercial team and made it stick, and can talk openly about the times it didn't. 
 Use AI as a matter of course in how you work, and think carefully about where it shouldn't be used. 
 This Role Is Not a Great Fit If You… 
 Want an analyst role. You'll own outcomes here, not just the reporting on them. 
 Are looking for an established RevOps function to join. You'll be building much of it. 
 Have only ever worked on new business and haven't had to think about what happens to a customer after they sign. 
 Prefer to stay in the tooling rather than have direct conversations with sales and CS leaders about pipeline, forecast and process. 
 Want a large team around you or a manager who sets the agenda. Decisions live with you. 
 Are used to a large-enterprise pace where change is slow and heavily governed.

Qualio is a unified quality and compliance management platform that helps regulated organizations get products to market faster with reduced risk. Trusted by biopharma, medtech, and diagnostics companies worldwide, Qualio eliminates fragmented systems that create audit delays and compliance blind spots. Our platform enables audit readiness in weeks through multi-standard automated gap analysis and evidence reuse across ISO and FDA requirements. Build strong relationships with your assigned customer portfolio and support them as their the key contact and advocate 
Drive upgrade revenue from deep understanding of customers’ business and goals to identify opportunities for product feature adoption and expanded usage
Collaborate with Product, Marketing, and Sales teams to advocate for your customers and proactively find ways to grow our customer base

Customer utilization of 3+ features in the platform

 Benefits

title: EMEA Strategy Lead, AWS EMEA Sales Strategy
description:
Description
 Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the pioneer and recognized leader in Cloud Computing. Our web services provide a platform for IT infrastructure in-the-cloud that is used by hundreds of thousands of developers and businesses around the world. The EMEA AWS Global Sales (AGS) Strategy Team architects the future of cloud computing across EMEA, influencing how thousands of organizations - from innovative startups to Fortune 500 companies - leverage AWS's 200+ services to transform their businesses. These strategic initiatives help define how AWS serves millions of customers across diverse markets and industries, driving cloud adoption and digital transformation across the region.
In the EMEA Strategy team, we work closely with our internal business leaders to glean their knowledge, incorporate data from external sources, and develop our own insights to inform and drive change across our EMEA sales organization. As we operate in a hypergrowth environment where speed meets scale, you'll help shape strategic decisions that impact millions of customers across EMEA. You'll face challenging, undefined problems that require both analytical rigor and creative thinking, while maintaining our scrappy, innovative approach to problem-solving. You'll tackle complex challenges in an environment where change is constant and opportunities for impact are unlimited. Each day brings new opportunities to shape how AWS adapts and grows in one of the world's most dynamic technology markets, requiring both agility and strategic thinking to stay ahead of market trends and customer needs.
We are currently hiring for an EMEA Strategy Lead. As an EMEA Strategy Lead, you will own strategic analysis and end-to-end project alignment, and act as a key connection point between and integrator of WW and EMEA strategy. The ideal candidate will have strong strategy experience, a deep analytical background, financial acumen, and experience implementing complex global sales strategy initiatives. They will have experience working closely with leadership to drive growth and a customer-first mindset, and bring the foresight required to anticipate business needs, make short- and long-term trade-offs, and balance business dynamics despite constraints. Strong judgement and a demonstrated ability to influence without explicit authority are keys to success, as well as knowing where and when to advocate vigorously for a well-informed position.
AWS Global Sales drives adoption of the AWS cloud worldwide, enabling customers of all sizes to innovate and expand in the cloud. Our team empowers every customer to grow by providing tailored service, unmatched technology, and consistent support. We dive deep to understand each customer's unique challenges, then craft innovative solutions that accelerate their success. This customer-first approach is how we built the world's most adopted cloud. Join us and help us grow.
Key job responsibilities
 Drive strategic recommendations for EMEA within AWS Global Sales organization, guiding investments to achieve organizational goals
 Develop relationships with senior leaders across organizations to gain and share strategic insights, serving as a trusted advisor on complex business decisions
 Manage highly complex and visible strategic initiatives. Influence cross-functional teams and leaders to drive business decisions with a focus on growth and efficient scaling of the business (e.g., data driven recommendations over sales investment and coverage models)
 Conduct qualitative and quantitative research, develop insights and analysis, and synthesize learnings to author proposals of strategic importance that drive change in EMEA and across AWS Global Sales
 Partner closely with Sales, Sales Operations and Planning teams to design/establish/improve mechanisms to monitor and review success metrics with key stakeholders
 Up to 15% travel, including international
 About The Team
 About AWS

Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. Mentorship & Career Growth
We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.

We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve.

title: Senior Customer Success Manager
description:
Mention Me pride ourselves in providing end-end acquisition solutions to our customers through our leading AI-powered referral marketing solution. Backed by Octopus Ventures and Eight Roads, we’ve raised $32 million in funding since 2018.
Since 2013, our award-winning acquisition platform has driven over 9 million new customers, generating $3 billion in incremental revenue for our clients.
There’s a good chance you’ve already come across us while online shopping from ASOS, PUMA, Gymshark, Charlotte Tilbury, or any other of the 500+ global brands we work with.
Becoming a Mentioneer means you’ll be joining a driven team, with big plans, at a genuinely exciting time for our business.
Role Overview
As a Senior Customer Success Manager, you will own the post-sale relationship with our most valuable accounts; complex organisations with multi-stakeholder buying committees, and sophisticated technical environments. You will be the trusted advisor and executive sponsor these customers rely on to realise value, expand their use of the platform, and become champions of our product inside their organisations.
This role demands someone who is genuinely comfortable operating at the most senior levels of a large businesses. You will spend the majority of your time on-site with customers, building relationships across the levels of their business, challenging conventional thinking, and guiding organisations through significant changes in how they approach marketing, customer acquisition, and advocacy.
This is not a remote-first, reactive role. It requires presence, gravitas, and the ability to navigate the complexity and politics that come with managing relationships inside complex organisations. 
You must be willing and able to travel 30% or more of your time to customer locations across the UK and internationally.
Key Responsibilities
Executive Stakeholder Engagement
Build and own trusted relationships at C-suite and VP level across your portfolio, including CMOs, CEOs, CTOs, and their direct reports, ensuring you are seen as a strategic partner rather than a vendor contact.
Develop a deliberate executive engagement plan for each account, mapping influence, stakeholder mapping, and building relationships that exist independently of any single point of contact.
Lead and facilitate executive business reviews (EBRs) that speak the language of business outcomes, not product features. Connecting platform ROI to board-level priorities.
Be unafraid to challenge executive stakeholders constructively, pushing back on misaligned strategies and guiding large organisations out of their comfort zone when it serves their long-term success.
Navigating Large Enterprise Organisations
Chair and lead complex, multi-workstream programmes within accounts of different sizes, coordinating across CRM, Marketing, Customer Experience, Data, and IT teams simultaneously.
Navigate the internal politics, competing priorities, and slow decision-making cycles that characterise organisations in different industries, building coalitions of support and maintaining momentum through change.
Identify and develop internal champions at multiple levels of the organisation, ensuring adoption and advocacy is not reliant on a single sponsor.
Manage complex stakeholder matrices with diplomacy, patience, and strategic intent, knowing when to escalate, when to push, and when to listen.
Account Growth & Revenue
Own Net Revenue Retention (NRR) and Gross Revenue Retention (GRR) targets for your portfolio of enterprise accounts.
Proactively identify and qualify expansion opportunities, including upsell, cross-sell, and new use cases. 
Lead commercial negotiations for renewals and multi-year contract expansions, building a compelling business case grounded in demonstrated value.
Understand the procurement and budget cycles of businesses and plan your commercial engagement accordingly.
Value Realisation & Onboarding
Lead the onboarding of new enterprise customers, orchestrating cross-functional internal teams (Operationss Support, Product) to deliver fast, measurable time-to-value.
Co-develop tailored Success Plans with each customer that map platform capabilities to their specific strategic objectives, with clear milestones and measurable KPIs.
Act as a subject matter expert on the platform and its application to marketing, CRM, advocacy, and organic growth, guiding customers through the adoption lifecycle with authority and confidence.
Voice of the Customer
Represent the customer's perspective and interests internally, synthesising feedback from across your portfolio to influence product roadmap, pricing, and packaging decisions.
Develop referenceable customers and support Marketing with case studies, testimonials, event speakers, and community participation.
Collaborate with the marketing team to support client retention and advocacy initiatives, positioning your accounts as proof points for the platform's impact.
Essential Experience
5+ years in a Customer Success, Strategic Account Management, or Management Consulting role, with a minimum of 3 years working exclusively with strategic accounts.
Proven, demonstrable experience building and managing executive-level relationships (VP and above) within large, matrixed organisations, this is non-negotiable.
A track record of successfully navigating complex organisations of different sizes, industry and geography: managing multiple stakeholder groups, chairing cross-functional programmes, and sustaining engagement across long sales and success cycles.
Demonstrable history of retaining and growing revenue within a large portfolio, with clear examples of upsell and expansion driven through relationship-led strategy.
Background in Martech, CRM, CDP, marketing automation, or data-driven marketing technology strongly preferred; experience as a CRM or marketing practitioner is a significant advantage.
Comfortable with 30%+ travel to customer sites, predominantly UK with some international travel required.
Approaches AI as a practical tool for doing better work; whether that's faster research, sharper prep for client calls, or smarter prioritisation. Should use it to support reporting, analyse health signals and scale personalisation. 
Skills & Competencies
Executive presence: you are credible, composed, and confident engaging with senior stakeholders. They respect your perspective and value your counsel
Fearless challenger: you are comfortable pushing back on C-suite stakeholders, guiding large organisations through uncomfortable change, and standing firm when it is in the customer's best interest. You are influential, credible and professional.
Enterprise navigator: you understand how complex organisations work: the politics, the approval structures, the competing agendas. You find a way through, not around.
Commercially sharp: you identify expansion signals early, build compelling business cases, and understand how to structure commercial conversations with enterprise procurement teams. You are data driven, metric savvy and effective forecasting.
Consultative and curious: you ask the right questions, listen deeply, connect business challenges to platform solutions, and tailor your approach to each organisation's maturity and goals.
Data-driven: you are comfortable using usage data, dashboards, and ROI analysis to substantiate your recommendations and build compelling narratives for renewal and expansion. You identify solutions to optimise processes to make decisions faster, with less risk. 
Highly organised: you manage a complex, high-value portfolio without dropping the ball, and you know when to delegate versus when to stay close.
Diversity, Equality & Inclusion
We celebrate every Mentioneer, exactly as they are. We don't shy away from breaking down systemic discrimination in society, or from difficult conversations and decisions. We're committed to being a force for change. You can read more about how we're doing this by checking out our blogs here.
The same goes for our recruitment. We welcome every application, regardless of race, religion or belief, ethnic origin, physical ability, family structure, socioeconomic status, age, nationality or citizenship, marital, domestic or civil partnership status, sexual orientation or gender identity.
Here are some of our favourite perks and benefits, but we have so many more!
Hybrid working
Private medical insurance with Vitality, including enhanced mental wellbeing support, dental and vision policies and a range of lifestyle benefits and great incentives
Life insurance
Two Celebration Days; additional time off for you to celebrate religious days, cultural events, birthdays, anniversaries, or any other significant day that’s important to you
Enhanced parental leave
25 days annual leave (plus public holidays), increasing over your time as a Mentioneer
Up-to-date tech you’ll need (we love Macs)

description:
About SoSafe
 SoSafe is a leading human risk management platform designed to transform the "human factor" from a security vulnerability into a proactive layer of defense. We focus on driving measurable behavior change and quantifiable risk reduction for our global customers.
 Your Role: Drive Sales Performance & Velocity
 As Revenue Operations Manager for Sales Excellence, you will be the strategic partner to our Sales leadership and the operational engine behind our Account Executives. Across the SaaS industry, sales cycles have recently increased by 3-4 weeks on average. Furthermore, industry-wide SQL to Closed-Won conversion rates have dropped. Your core mission is to counteract these market headwinds by optimizing our sales mechanics, critical processes, and pipeline management.
You will ensure that our AEs spend less time on administrative friction and more time executing a frictionless, high-converting sales process tailored to our mid-market European buyers.
 What You Will Own (key Responsibilities)
Operationalize the 2026 ICP: Drive strict alignment with our new Ideal Customer Profile, focusing our AE efforts on corporate to mid-enterprise EU organizations with 500 to 5,000 employees. Equip the sales team to prioritize accounts in regulated industries (e.g., Manufacturing, Finance, Healthcare) that are driven by compliance mandates like NIS2 and DORA.
Optimize our Buyer Journey: Tailor our Salesforce deal stages and qualification methodology to engage the right stakeholders at the right time. Specifically, build workflows that help AEs navigate the Head of IT, who acts as the primary decision-maker in our core mid-market deals.
Pipeline & Forecasting: Manage our Clari forecasting architecture to move the sales organization from "available data" to "actionable insights." Track and optimize foundational sales metrics such as Pipeline Velocity, Average Time in Stage, and Stage Conversion. Ensure pipeline health by maintaining a target Pipeline Coverage ratio of 3-4x. 
Deal Desk & Approval Processes: Own and refine the Deal Desk and commercial approval processes within Salesforce. Create a streamlined pricing and discounting framework that protects our margins while accelerating deal velocity.
Tech Stack Optimization: Maximize the ROI of our GTM tech stack, acting as the business owner for tools like Salesloft or Clari. Implement AI-driven intelligence and automation to improve rep productivity.
Cross-Functional Alignment: Act as the strategic bridge between CS, Sales and Marketing leadership as well as our Product Organisation to build a friction-free customer journey. Align sales processes with our target mid-market enterprise ICP (501–5,000 employee companies in highly regulated sectors).
 What You Bring (requirements)
Experience: 5+ years of professional experience in Revenue Operations, Sales Operations, or Sales Strategy ideally within a high-growth B2B SaaS environment.
Sales Process Mastery: You possess a deep understanding of B2B sales methodologies (MEDDIC etc.) and know how to hardwire these frameworks directly into CRM validation rules and sales stages.
Analytical & Financial mindset: You are highly fluent in modern SaaS and sales performance metrics. You deeply understand the mechanics of Win Rates, Sales Cycle Length, CAC Payback, Net Magic Number, and the Rule of 40.
Tech Stack Expertise: Advanced administration and architectural experience with Salesforce (SFDC) and a leading forecasting platform (Clari preferred). Familiarity with Salesloft or similar sales engagement platforms is highly advantageous.
Strategic Execution: You are not a reactive ticket-taker. You proactively analyze Pipeline Flow and Forecast vs. Actuals dashboards to identify bottlenecks and present data-backed recommendations to the CRO and Director of RevOps.
 Why Join the SoSafe RevOps Team?
A Seat at the Table: Our RevOps organization manages the entire GTM stack and architecture. You will have direct exposure to executive leaders (CRO, COO, and Director of RevOps) and have a large, visible impact on our profitability journey.
Cutting-Edge Stack: We don’t tolerate legacy tech debt. You will work with a modern infrastructure, including Salesforce, HubSpot, Salesloft, Clari CoPilot, and cutting-edge tools like Clay or Claude.
Team Culture: Join a highly collaborative group of operations professionals and GTM engineers who balance top-tier technical performance with wit, humility, and zero ego. And join our fun team events!
 What we offer*
Work/Life balance: Flexible hours, 33 vacation days
Wellbeing and financial support: Access to Open Up, corporate discounts
Connection & community: Virtual events, collaborative team activities, and opportunities for local meet-ups
And the list goes on: Tech equipment, referral bonuses, dog-friendly HQ
Perks and benefits listed above are for full-time employees and may vary slightly by office location. These are just a sample — you'll learn more during the interview process.
 About Us
 At SoSafe, we’re on a mission to make the digital world safer by addressing the human factor in cybersecurity. As one of the fastest-growing security awareness scale-ups worldwide, we leverage behavioural science and data-driven learning to empower people against cyber threats. Our Human Risk Management approach helps organisations turn their employees into their strongest line of defence.
Backed by leading VCs like Highland Europe and Global Founders Capital, we’re rapidly expanding across the globe. We’re looking for team players who want to drive meaningful change in cybersecurity, take ownership of their work, and grow with us.
If you thrive in a vibrant, purpose-driven environment that values innovation, diversity, and collaboration, then this is the place for you!

 Qualifications, Experience And Skills

 Success criteria

title: Head of Revenue Operations
description:
As our Head of Revenue Operations (RevOps), you'll bridge strategy and execution, combining strong analytical skills with commercial acumen to help leadership understand what's working, what's not, and what to do next.
Reporting to the VP Operations, you'll work with a high degree of autonomy and partner closely with the CRO (through the Chief of Staff) and the CFO. You'll lead two RevOps Managers—one focused on new business and one on expansion—and collaborate closely with the DataOps team on systems and technical implementation.
This role is built around three core strengths: business insight —turning data into meaningful recommendations; translation —connecting leadership priorities with day-to-day execution; and strategic operations —owning the metrics, cadences, and processes that drive commercial performance.
 Working closely with the Chief of Staff to the CRO , you'll provide the analytical backbone behind our commercial strategy. While they drive GTM strategy and cross-functional execution, you'll ensure decisions are backed by clear insights, robust business cases, and performance tracking that keeps the organization aligned and accountable.
 Your 12-month journey 
 First 3 months: Immerse yourself in the business. Understand the ARR snowball, funnel mechanics, key commercial levers, and the stakeholder landscape across new business and expansion. Build strong relationships with the CRO’s Chief of Staff, Finance leadership, and GTM team leads. Take ownership of the reporting cadence and QBR preparation. Start cross-checking numbers with the teams — get to a level of data confidence that doesn’t exist today.
 First 6 months: Own the full operating rhythm: weekly forecast and business reviews, monthly deep-dives, quarterly business reviews. Deliver improved pipeline health tracking and ARR analysis. Present your first strategic recommendations on territory coverage, commission impact, or forecast adjustments. Be able to produce a reforecast on the fly based on your understanding of the business.
 First 12 months: Leadership relies on your analysis to make headcount, territory, and investment decisions. You’ve built the business cases that shaped this year’s commercial strategy. If we want to grow from 15% to 20%, you’re the first person we go to for where to allocate that growth.
 What you’ll be doing 
 Business insights & analytical ownership (~50% of your time): This is your primary mandate. You are the person who is kept awake at night until the numbers are clear and understood. Own the analytical layer that drives leadership decisions: ARR dynamics, cohort analysis, pipeline velocity, conversion patterns, churn drivers, NRR, GRR, CAC ratios — per dimension, per segment. You don’t just build reports; you interpret them, cross-check them with the teams, flag anomalies, and push the organization to act. When something unexpected happens — an unusual churn spike, a self-service trend shift, an expansion initiative underperforming — you’re the one who digs in and comes back with an explanation and a recommendation.
 Operating cadence & accountability (~40% with GTM teams): Design and run the commercial operating rhythm in partnership with the Chief of Staff. Own the weekly forecast and business review cadence, monthly analysis cycles, QBRs (with the right metrics and the right view), and budget/reforecasting processes. You set the expectations, prepare the materials, track initiative efficiency (A/B testing, dashboarding), and ensure follow-through. When a reforecast is needed, you flag it and drive it.
 Translation & strategic recommendations: You are the translator between the ground and the top. You turn field-level signals into structured insights for Ops leadership and the CRO team. You translate corporate objectives and the Ops roadmap into priorities and actions for the GTM teams. You build business cases that support key commercial decisions: commission scheme design, territory adjustments, growth allocation, capacity planning.
 Team leadership: Lead and develop two RevOps Managers — one dedicated to new business, one to expansion. Ensure they operate with the same level of analytical rigor and business understanding you bring. Coach them to become strong business partners to the GTM leaders they support.
 Cross-functional partnership: Work closely with the Chief of Staff to the CRO on QBR preparation, performance intelligence, and strategic initiatives. Partner with the DataOps team for system architecture, integrations, and technical builds. Collaborate with Finance on unit economics, budget tracking, and reforecasting.
 What you bring 
 We’re looking for someone who has been the #1 RevOps / Business Operations leader in a B2B SaaS company in the €50m–€100m ARR range, or a strong #2 in a larger organization (€100m–€250m ARR). You lead with business judgment and analytical depth — not systems administration. 
 Must-haves 
Proven experience leading a RevOps or Business Operations function end-to-end in B2B SaaS, with direct ownership of business metrics and commercial cadences.
Deep understanding of recurring revenue models, ARR mechanics, and commercial finance: NRR, GRR, CAC ratios, commissions, capacity planning, unit economics.
Obsessive analytical rigor: you cross-check, you dig in, you don’t stop until the numbers tell a coherent story. You can produce a reforecast on the go.
Proven track record of producing analytical work that drives executive decisions — business cases, scenario models, strategic recommendations — not just dashboards.
Strong stakeholder management: you present to C-levels, challenge assumptions, and hold commercial leaders accountable. You do this through credibility and data, not authority.
Experience designing and running operating cadences: weekly business reviews, QBRs, forecast cycles. You know what good looks like and you enforce it.
Team management experience: you’ve built or led a small RevOps team and can develop people.
English at C2 level. Fluency in Dutch or French is a strong advantage.
 Nice-to-haves 
Experience with HubSpot, Planhat, Modjo, or Qobra.
Familiarity with BI tools (Metabase or similar) and SQL — enough to pull your own analysis autonomously.
Exposure to data engineering concepts (dbt, data warehousing) — enough to collaborate with a DataOps team.
Awareness of how AI is evolving the ops operating model.
Experience working across multiple European geographies (NL, FR, DE).
What we offer
Flexibility to work from home and from our canal side office in Amsterdam
A chance to shape one of the most ambitious scale-ups in Europe
Work in a diverse and multicultural team
€1,500 annual training budget plus internal training
Pension plan, travel reimbursement, and wellness perks
28 paid holiday days + 2 additional days to relax
Work from anywhere for 4 weeks/year
Apple MacBook and tools
€200 home office budget
 This role can be both based in Amsterdam, The Netherlands or Paris, France. Benefits can differ based on location. 
 About Tellent 
Tellent is a Talent Management Suite that helps organizations attract, hire, manage, and grow their people. Our platform combines Applicant Tracking, HRIS, and Performance Management solutions used by 7,000+ companies across 100+ countries.
With 250+ employees across Europe, we’re building intuitive and scalable HR technology that helps companies create better employee experiences.
 AI in our recruitment process 
We use our internally developed AI tools to help streamline our recruitment process. However, technology never makes a decision. Every candidate is personally reviewed by our team. Your journey with us is guided by people, supported by tech. Curious about how it works? Read our AI Statement , check our Privacy Policy, or chat with us at hr@tellent.com.

title: Customer Success Manager
description:
Ben jij een strategische gesprekspartner die kansen ziet voordat de klant ze zelf ziet? Krijg jij energie van het bouwen aan langdurige klantrelaties én het realiseren van resultaten? Dan hebben wij een mooie uitdaging voor jou!
Wij zijn namelijk op zoek naar een Customer Success Manager.
 Over Dynamic People 
Geen standaard club, geen standaard projecten. We zijn een hecht team van consultants, developers en strategen die werken met de nieuwste Microsoft-technologieën. Samen bouwen we slimme oplossingen voor complexe vraagstukken.
Met onze diepgaande businesskennis en expertise in Microsoft Dynamics 365 (ERP & CRM), Power Platform, Azure, Data en AI, begeleiden we organisaties van strategie tot en met implementatie en beheer.
Onze cultuur? Ondernemend, gedreven en wij werken samen. Wij doen dit elke dag met veel plezier, geen onnodige bureaucratie, maar korte lijnen, veel verantwoordelijkheid en ruimte voor eigen initiatief. We vieren successen samen en geloven dat onze mensen het verschil maken.
 Jouw uitdaging 
Als Customer Success Manager ben jij dé schakel tussen de klanten, organisatie en onze dienstverlening. Je begrijpt de ambities van de klant, vertaalt deze naar concrete oplossingen en services en zorgt ervoor dat klanten blijvend waarde halen uit hun Dynamics 365-omgeving.
Je voert strategische gesprekken, ontwikkelt klant-roadmaps en brengt als regisseur de juiste mensen samen om kansen te realiseren. Je bent regelmatig bij klanten aanwezig, werkt ook vanuit ons kantoor in Amsterdam en werkt nauw samen met Sales, Marketing, Managed Services, Delivery en Microsoft om gezamenlijk klantdoelstellingen te realiseren.
Jij zorgt ervoor dat klanten niet alleen tevreden zijn, maar echte ambassadeurs van Dynamic People worden.
 Wat ga je doen? 
Je bouwt aan sterke relaties met klanten en bent hun vertrouwde adviseur.
Je ontwikkelt en bewaakt klant-roadmaps gericht op groei en innovatie.
Je identificeert nieuwe kansen voor upsell, cross-sell en aanvullende dienstverlening.
Je initieert, regisseert en werkt actief mee aan offertes, business cases en pre sales trajecten.
Je organiseert kennissessies, workshops en strategische overleggen.
Je verzamelt klantfeedback en vertaalt deze naar verbeteringen binnen onze dienstverlening.
 Wat breng jij mee? 
Minimaal 5 jaar ervaring als Customer Succes Manager, Account Manager, Consultant of een vergelijkbare klantgerichte rol.
Kennis van Microsoft Dynamics 365 CRM, ERP, Power Platform, Dataplatformen en ontwikkelingen op AI-gebied houd je bij.
Kennis van CPQ producten en de wereld van Commodity Traders is mooi meegenomen.
Ervaring met stakeholdermanagement op verschillende niveaus.
Een commerciële mindset en het vermogen om kansen te herkennen én te verzilveren.
Sterke communicatieve vaardigheden en het vermogen om klanten mee te nemen in een visie en roadmap.
 Je bent: 
Ondernemend en proactief.
Van nature een relatiebouwer.
Werkt gestructureerd.
Strategisch sterk, maar ook praktisch ingesteld.
Nieuwsgierig naar business, technologie en innovatie.
 Wat bieden wij jou? 
Bij Dynamic People werken we niet alleen met de meest innovatieve technologieën, maar geloven we ook in een people-first cultuur waarin jouw groei en welzijn centraal staan. Je krijgt de kans om een waardevolle bijdrage te leveren aan het succes van onze klanten, met alle ruimte om je persoonlijk en professioneel te ontwikkelen. Wij geloven in eigenaarschap en verantwoordelijkheid en bieden jou de tools en ondersteuning om echt impact te maken.
Een competitief salaris, bonusschema en uitstekende secundaire arbeidsvoorwaarden waaronder een mobiliteitsvergoeding, pensioenregeling, telefoonvergoeding en laptop.
Ruimte om te groeien: we bieden volop kansen voor professionele ontwikkeling en helpen je om door te groeien binnen de organisatie.
Flexibele werktijden en 27+ vakantiedagen, zodat je het werk kunt combineren met een fijne werk-privébalans.
Een energieke werkomgeving: elke dag een geweldige lunch, leuke collega’s, vrijdagmiddagborrels, uitjes, bootcamps en ons jaarlijks weekendje weg met het hele team!

title: CS Operations & Onboarding Specialist
description:
Job DescriptionJob Description
We are on the search for a CS Operations & Onboarding Specialist! We are seeking someone ready to roll up their sleeves to support our Revenue Operations team. Reporting to our Sales Operations Manager, you will be responsible for driving process improvement and automation across the customer lifecycle, project-managing customer onboarding from kickoff through go-live, owning renewals and CSM responsibilities for our smaller accounts, and serving as the first line of support for our Renewals and Customer Success inbox and ticketing queue. 
 What you'll do: 
 Process Improvement & Automation 
Serve as the RevOps planner for the Customer Success team — own automation initiatives and drive continuous process improvements and workflow optimization across the customer lifecycle. 
Lead process improvement and administration projects with our regional Business Partners, ensuring our processes scale cleanly as the partner network grows. 
Act as a trusted point of contact for our EMEA Business Partner network, providing guidance on tools, process, and account questions to help them succeed with their customers. 
 Onboarding Program Management 
Act as project manager for new customer onboarding, partnering with Professional Services to build and roll out onboarding processes and documentation for key accounts. 
Coordinate end-to-end onboarding for new customers, from initial contact through go-live and beyond. 
Act as the primary point of contact for customers during onboarding, resolving questions and concerns promptly. 
Partner with Sales, Customer Success, Professional Services, Customer Support, and Business Partners to ensure cross-functional alignment and resolve onboarding issues. 
Build and maintain onboarding plans, timelines, and documentation to keep every project on schedule. 
Track project progress and provide regular status updates to customers and internal stakeholders, including recurring syncs with Business Partners and Professional Services. 
 Renewals & Customer Success 
Serve as CSM for a portfolio of smaller accounts (under $10K ARR), managing product requests, demos, upsell opportunities, and churn prevention. 
Act as the focal point for data-related requests — backups, selective data restoration, and account splits — from quoting through fulfillment and customer communication. 
Ensure data integrity and reliable information flow across our billing and CRM systems. 
 Support Operations 
Serve as the first point of contact for the Renewals/Customer Success inbox and support ticketing queue. 
Monitor, triage, and assign incoming tickets across the team. 
Own SOP approvals and documentation for the team. 
 What you'll bring: 
3+ years of relevant experience in customer success, onboarding, renewals, or revenue operations within a SaaS/CRM or related industry. 
Proven project management skills, with experience building and managing onboarding plans, timelines, and cross-functional stakeholders. 
A track record of managing multiple priorities in a deadline-driven environment with a high degree of autonomy in a fast-paced, rapidly changing environment. 
Accuracy, analytical skills, and attention to detail, especially when handling account and billing data. 
Strong communication and relationship-management skills, comfortable acting as a primary point of contact for customers and internal stakeholders alike. 
Experience triaging and resolving tickets in a helpdesk/ticketing tool (e.g., Zendesk) is an asset. 
Familiarity with CRM, billing, and quoting systems, and comfort learning new internal tools quickly. 
 Why you should apply: 
???? Competitive Salaries with RRSP matching program 
???? Generous paid vacay and sick days 
???? A powerful Laptop 
???? Budget for courses, books, and personal development 
❤️ Peer to peer recognition and rewards 
???? Team building events, happy hours and more 
???????? Flexible & hybrid work 
 About Maximizer 
Maximizer was launched in a garage on Vancouver Island in 1987, evolving through the development of early contact management systems (CMS), through sales force automation (SFA) technologies, right to today's sophisticated customer relationship management (CRM) systems. Along the way, we have pioneered many of today's technologies. Over this 30-year history we have attracted over 100,000 customers from around the world, and 1 million users. 
Today, we are one of the few CRM providers in the world who can deploy our software in all three environments of on-premise, private or shared cloud, while providing access via a desktop/laptop, via a mobile device, or using the Maximizer app. 
Ultimately, however, we are successful because for over three decades we have proven we know how to help customers do three things: secure new customers; retain them for the long term; and maximize the repeat business from them. 
 Equal Opportunity Employer 
We are an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate based on race, faith, colour, cultural background, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, or disability status. We thank all applicants for their interest, however, only those selected for an interview will be contacted. 
 Salary Range $65,000—$75,000 CAD

 About Lorum 
The structural conflict at the centre of correspondent banking is not technological. It is economic. Banks earn revenue from their balance sheets: they lend deposits, capture FX spreads, and hold funds as long as it is rational to do so. Clearing, the act of releasing funds quickly and predictably, competes directly with those economics. An institution designed to lend has a structural incentive to hold deposits; an institution designed to clear has an incentive to release them. When one institution does both, clearing loses. The result is unpredictable settlement, trapped capital, and a correspondent network shrinking by design.

title: Head of Customer Success
description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Head of Customer Success based in Belgium.
 This is a senior, hands-on leadership role responsible for shaping the entire post-sale customer experience within a fast-growing B2B SaaS environment. You will own retention, expansion, and adoption outcomes while developing the strategies and systems that support sustainable customer growth. Working closely with senior leadership, you will combine strategic direction with direct involvement in key customer relationships. You will lead and develop an expanding Customer Success team while establishing scalable playbooks across onboarding, adoption, renewal, and expansion. The role offers significant autonomy and the opportunity to build the Customer Success function during an important stage of company growth. Success will be measured through meaningful business outcomes, customer value, and recurring revenue rather than activity alone.
Accountabilities
Own overall Customer Success strategy and execution, with direct accountability for retention, expansion, Net Revenue Retention (NRR), and churn outcomes.
Drive customer adoption by increasing both the breadth and depth of product usage across the customer base.
Coach, enable, and actively support the Customer Success team, stepping directly into strategic accounts when intervention or additional leadership is required.
Lead, develop, and scale the Customer Success organization as the business grows, including hiring and onboarding future team members.
Build and continuously refine a scalable Customer Success playbook covering onboarding, adoption, success planning, renewal, and expansion.
Establish customer success plans, health-scoring frameworks, account-management standards, and repeatable processes tied to measurable retention and expansion outcomes.
Partner closely with Sales, Product, and Engineering to communicate customer needs, surface opportunities, and represent the voice of the customer.
Maintain accurate visibility into customer health, risks, opportunities, and performance through HubSpot or comparable CRM systems.
Proactively identify accounts at risk as well as expansion opportunities, developing practical and actionable recommendations for leadership.
Build a culture of ownership and customer value, ensuring processes and team activity remain closely connected to business outcomes.
Use customer insights and performance data to continuously improve the Customer Success operating model.
 Requirements
Proven leadership experience in B2B SaaS Customer Success, including direct people-management responsibility.
Demonstrated experience owning retention and expansion metrics and coaching teams toward measurable commercial outcomes.
Hands-on leadership approach, with the ability to personally engage with strategic accounts while developing the team to operate effectively at scale.
Experience building, improving, or scaling Customer Success processes within an early-stage or high-growth company.
Strong understanding of the complete customer lifecycle, including onboarding, adoption, renewal, expansion, and account management.
Consultative and customer-focused mindset, with the ability to ask thoughtful questions, identify improvement opportunities, and recommend practical solutions.
Highly autonomous and proactive, able to identify priorities independently and take ownership without requiring extensive direction.
Strong proficiency with HubSpot, Salesforce, or similar CRM platforms.
Excellent analytical, organizational, communication, and stakeholder-management skills.
Exceptional written and spoken English.
Experience with customer health-scoring or Customer Success platforms such as Gainsight, Vitally, or similar tools is an advantage.
Familiarity with partner-led or channel-influenced Customer Success models is a plus.
 Benefits

 Hitachi Solutions is a global Microsoft solutions integrator passionate about developing and delivering industry-focused solutions that support our clients to deliver on their business transformation goals.  Job Description
 Senior Sales Enablement Specialist
 Location: Canada remote
 Position Summary
 The Senior Sales Enablement Specialist is responsible for developing, implementing, and managing programs that improve seller productivity, reinforce sales methodologies, drive tool adoption, and enable consistent execution across the sales organization. This role partners closely with Sales Leadership, Sales Operations, Marketing, Alliances, and Product teams to ensure sellers and managers have the skills, content, tools, and processes necessary to achieve predictable revenue growth.
The Sales Enablement Senior Specialist serves as the bridge between sales strategy and field execution, ensuring that selling standards are translated into practical workflows, learning experiences, content, and coaching programs that drive measurable business outcomes.

 Sales Readiness

 Content Strategy & Management

Curate, organize, and maintain:

Proposal resources
Competitive positioning assets

 Tool Adoption & Enablement
